name: Propensity Score Matching
when_to_use: Evaluate the effect of a treatment/program without random assignment; match treated and untreated cases with a similar profile (probability of treatment) before comparing the outcome.
notes: Matches treated and untreated cases with a similar profile to compare outcomes as if it were an experiment. Applications: evaluate the effect of a program/training without a random control group.

expected_input.question: What would the outcome of the treated have been had they not been treated, using similar cases as the counterfactual?

plain_explanation.purpose: Compares treated and untreated cases that were similar from the start, to isolate the treatment effect.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there was no random assignment and the groups differ in profile.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A 'treated/not' column, the outcome and profile factors for each case.
plain_explanation.example: Measure the effect of a training program on salary by comparing similar people.
plain_explanation.diagram: each treated -> similar untreated match -> compare outcomes
